In addition to this, he is also a famous chef. At Restaurant Le Yeah, a woman talks about how he sometimes prepares meals for [[Grant]] and [[Valerie]]. {{left clear}} In {{g|Legends: Z-A}}, set five years after Pokémon X and Y, several NPCs around [[Lumiose City]] discuss Siebold and his cooking. {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Siebold/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Siebold anime.png|250px|thumb|Siebold in ''[[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]]'']] Siebold is a member of [[Kalos]] [[Elite Four]], and also operates a luxury restaurant where he is the head chef. He appeared in ''[[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]]''. [[Alain]] paid a visit to Siebold's restaurant, hoping to battle him. Siebold soon noticed his [[Mega Ring]], and promptly escorted Alain to his private battlefield for the match. Alain immediately [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] his {{TP|Alain|Charizard}}, while Siebold saved his own Mega Evolution for a bit later. His Blastoise was shown to be very well trained, being able to withstand an attack from Alain's Mega Charizard X even when not Mega Evolved itself. Per Alain's request, he then Mega Evolved his Blastoise into Mega Blastoise. Even though Charizard battled hard, it was finally unable to defeat an Elite Four level Mega Evolution, being defeated with a [[Type#Type effectiveness|supereffective]], {{a|Mega Launcher}}-powered {{m|Dragon Pulse}}. However, Siebold was impressed by Alain's battle performance, especially in the face of a type disadvantage. He appeared again during a flashback in ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]''. ====Character==== Siebold is bold and distinguished. He rarely accepts {{pkmn|battle}} requests, though will make special accommodations for particularly strong {{pkmn|Trainer}}s like [[Alain]]. He bided his time in battle before unleashing his full-force power against [[Alain's Charizard]]. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Siebold's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Siebold |pkmn=Blastoise |mega=yes |type1=Water |img=Siebold Blastoise.png |cap=Siebold's Blastoise |img2=Siebold Mega Blastoise.png |cap2=Siebold's Mega Blastoise |epnum=XYS01 |epname=Mega Evolution Special I |desc={{p|Blastoise}} is Siebold's only known Pokémon. He used it to battle [[Alain]] and his [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] {{TP|Alain|Charizard}} X. During the battle, Blastoise was shown to be very powerful, defeating Charizard without too much trouble, although Charizard put up a good fight nonetheless. In the animated series, it appeared in a flashback in ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]''. Blastoise's known moves are {{m|Hydro Pump}}, {{m|Skull Bash}}, {{m|Dragon Pulse}}, and {{m|Power-Up Punch}}, and its [[Ability]] is {{a|Mega Launcher}} as a Mega Blastoise.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{water color light}}|bordercolor={{water color}} |ja=吉野裕行 ''Hiroyuki Yoshino'' |en=[[Eli James]] |id=Fitra Hartono }} ===GOTCHA!=== Siebold briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== [[File:Siebold Adventures.png|130px|thumb|Siebold in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Siebold debuts in the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. He is first mentioned by Diantha as she talked to [[Korrina]] about each of the Kalos Elite Four. He is first seen in person at the [[Lost Hotel]], cooking a meal for {{adv|X}} and his friends. Although his passion for cooking frightens the children somewhat, [[Ramos]] explains that Siebold is making the meal as a way of apologizing for his lack of participation against [[Team Flare]]. Later, Siebold, along with Drasna and Wikstrom, assists X's group in their quest to stop Team Flare. As X's group prepared to find where Team Flare had gone into hiding, Siebold provides them with lunch to eat on their journey. Afterward, Siebold battles members of Team Flare at {{rt|19|Kalos}}. After Team Flare is fully defeated, Siebold, the remaining Elite Four members, and Diantha carry the unconscious body of [[Malva]], who had turned out to be a member of Team Flare. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Siebold |width=82 |pkmn=Clawitzer |type1=Water |img=Siebold Clawitzer Adventures.png |epnum=PS582 |epname=Pinsir Glares |desc={{p|Clawitzer}} is Siebold's only known Pokémon. It was first seen alongside its Trainer at the Lost Hotel as he cooked for X and his friends. None of Clawitzer's moves are known.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:SieboldChillingReign198.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Siebold]] {{main|Siebold (Chilling Reign 153)}} '''Siebold''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Jet-Black Spirit}} expansion before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Chilling Reign}} expansion, with artwork by [[Ken Sugimori]]. It was also released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} and {{TCG|Secret card}} in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by [[Hideki Ishikawa]]. It allows the player to heal 60 damage from up to two of their {{TCG|Rapid Strike style|Rapid Strike}} Pokémon. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Siebold is the only notable {{type|Water}} [[Type expert|specialist]] to be an [[Elite Four]] member. * Siebold is the only member of the Kalos Elite Four to not have physically appeared in the {{pkmn|animated series}}. ** As such, he is also the only member of the Kalos Elite Four whom {{Ash}} never met in the animated series. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{water color}}; border:3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ズミ ''Zumi'' | From {{jwp|ズミ|酸実}} ''zumi'' ({{wp|Malus sieboldii|Siebold's crabapple}})[https://web.archive.org/web/20211025195039/https://twitter.com/matsumiyan/status/451700756715151360 Tweet by Toshinobu Matsumiya マツミや (@matsumiyan).
